validation.faultInjectionAndBenchmarks: isolated disposable repos and actual local Node/SDK child processes; scripted provider only
validation.timingQualification: Single-machine local measurements, not a throughput SLA or provider latency benchmark.

findings.title: Worker initialization loses cancellation
findings.reproduction: Inject abort into the registered message handler during runtime.getModel, before openAgent resolves. Real isolated SDK child still calls the scripted provider, edits the candidate, and returns candidate.

evidence.injection: abort handler called synchronously inside runtime.getModel while openAgent is initializing

findings.recommendation: Latch cancellation from child startup, pass a shared AbortSignal into run, and re-check after every initialization await and before dispatch.

findings.title: Leader exit cancels descendant SIGKILL escalation
findings.reproduction: A private child fixture spawns a same-group descendant that ignores SIGTERM. Force abort causes the leader to exit; supervisor clears the scheduled kill before descendant disappearance.

evidence.error: Workerまたはtool processの停止が未確認です。lockと予算予約を保持しました。

findings.recommendation: Retain bounded TERM/KILL cleanup until the owned process group is confirmed absent, independently of leader exit; include recorded tool groups.

findings.title: Latest-100 display query is used as the global unsettled-worker guard
findings.reproduction: Seed an unsettled worker in an old parent plus 100 newer sessions. Agent opening is allowed; recovery cannot find the actual reservation.

evidence.recoveryError: 未精算のWorker予約が見つかりません。

findings.recommendation: Use an unbounded/dedicated active-worker query and a Worker-ID lookup for safety and recovery. Keep display pagination separate.

findings.title: Search repeats synchronous rule and Git discovery per file
findings.recommendation: Cache repository identity and perform rules validation at bounded batch boundaries, preserving path checks. Yield/check AbortSignal during traversal and use bounded asynchronous reads.

confirmedControls: same rules, permission and edit scope in child
dirty source workspace retained while child edits isolated worktree
session budget reservation and usage settlement
no automatic provider fallback or retry
unconfirmed stop retains lock and reservation instead of declaring cleanup complete
managementLimits: single explicitly dispatched Worker; no DAG or parallel scheduler
routing configuration is not connected to automatic Worker assignment
no persistent suspend/resume and slot return during human questions
no owner lease/heartbeat recovery; PID and last activity are diagnostic evidence
no archive/retention policy for candidate worktrees; candidates are intentionally preserved
